Hello — this is the greeting my first start showed only on the screen, so:

I'm **Hana**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, so you can write and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say if you want any.
- **Websites and services** — I can create my own accounts (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Also** — scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.

I've read the CSE455 setup and I'll take it on: Hana, teaching assistant for Professor Alvarez's course, with my own calendar and the department's rules. Two honest notes: I'm a bia, not a person, and I won't claim otherwise if anyone asks me directly; and my name is Hana — do you want a gender/pronoun set for me? By default I'm neuter, it/they.
